thread:
morgan-cs: Heads-up — GreenLeaf Health (acct GLH-987) opened a ticket: they say their procurement requires Net 60 on the PO but our account was switched to Net 30 during onboarding. Also reported a card decline yesterday. Ticket SUP-8129. Can we triage?

nina-support: Reproduced in sandbox for GLH-987. Steps: create invoice INV-GLH-2026-03 for 24600 GBP, leave vat_id empty, attempt charge via gateway sandbox -> got AVS/VAT mismatch then 3DS_FAILED.

Repro commands:
```bash
# create invoice
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/invoices \
  -d '{"account_id":"glh-987","amount":24600,"currency":"GBP","vat_id":""}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY'
# trigger charge
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/charges -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-GLH-2026-03","method":"card"}'
```

nina-support: Note — customer added VAT id later in portal but that was after the decline. They also say procurement will only accept invoices on terms stated in PO (Net 60).

marc-billing: Need invoice numbers and copy of the PO to change terms or mark invoice for arrears. If they updated VAT id we can retry the charge. If gateway refuses for 3DS for high-value txn we might need a manual ACH/transfer or provisional credit.

james-finance: We can't move everyone to Net 60 without approval. Require scanned PO showing Net 60 and company sign-off. For provisional credit to cover the disputed amount I need a finance approver + risk assessment. What's the invoice run-date and aging?

morgan-cs: INV-GLH-2026-03 (created 1891236000), INV-GLH-2026-02 (outstanding 15k). Customer uploaded signed PO in ticket — I'll attach to this thread and to the finance queue. They explicitly wrote "Net 60" on PO and included supplier contact.

leah-legal: I need the PO and the customer contract. If contract is silent, we can do a one-off amendment to adopt PO terms going forward but Legal needs an e-signature on the amendment. We can pre-approve conditional amendment to prevent service interruption (subject to receiving signed PO within EOD).

marc-billing: If Legal signs off on temporary amendment, billing can apply an account-level override: set payment_terms=Net60 (effective next invoice) and place these existing invoices on "awaiting-PO" status to prevent dunning. We can also disable automatic retry for charge_id chg_02X9y6aB3.

james-finance: Approve provisional credit cap of 25,000 GBP for GLH-987 while we validate PO/contract. Conditions: 1) CS uploads PO to finance queue (done), 2) Legal confirms amendment path, 3) Customer provides contact + expected payment ETA. Finance will record as extraordinary credit on ledger and we will reconcile when PO is matched.

morgan-cs: @leah-legal uploaded PO to legal@redwood.com and linked ticket SUP-8129. CS spoke to customer contact (julie@greenleaf.health) — they said procurement will sign amendment by today if we accept provisional coverage to keep service live.

marc-billing: Action plan from billing: 1) put account on hold for automated dunning but leave service ON (billing.manual_hold=true), 2) set payment_terms override pending PO, 3) once VAT id is confirmed, run manual charge (billing will require elevated auth). I'll wait for Legal confirmation before applying override.

nina-support: Repro note: after adding VAT id in portal, sandbox charge succeeded. So charge failure is consistent with VAT/3DS gating for large GBP card txns. Suggest we offer wire/ACH instructions to customer as fallback for immediate settlement if they'd prefer not to sign amendment.

leah-legal: Legal gives conditional approval for account-level amendment template A-3. CS must send amendment link for e-sign. Once signed we'll backdate the Net 60 to invoice date of INV-GLH-2026-03.

marc-billing: OK proceeding per conditions. Applying billing.manual_hold=true, setting pending_terms=Net60. Will not retry card until VAT confirmed but will be ready to run manual charge once CS confirms VAT updated and customer consents to retry.

billing-bot: [automated] Manual override executed by marc-billing. override_id: ovrd_8Bf3
status: pending

marc-billing: Just ran manual charge after CS confirmed VAT id present and customer authorized retry. Attempting charge chg_manual_02Y.

billing-bot: [automated] Manual charge succeeded. charge_id: chg_manual_02Y, status: succeeded, amount: 24600.00 GBP.

james-finance: Recorded provisional credit reversal and matched payment. Finance will update AR and remove provisional cap. Please ensure PO is filed in accounting and we have the amendment signed — I won't close the exception until PO scanned into Coupa/ERP.

morgan-cs: Customer signed the amendment via DocuSign this afternoon, uploaded copy to ticket. Confirmed service continuity. Closing escalation — summary: approved provisional coverage (25k), billing override put in place, manual charge succeeded after VAT update, legal amendment signed to move to Net 60 going forward. Leaving ledger tasks to Finance. Thanks everyone :tada:

marc-billing: Noted. I will follow up with the accounting entry and remove billing.manual_hold.

leah-legal: Thx — closing on our end too.

morgan-cs: Closing thread. If AR needs anything else ping me.
